g.text: Complete-cycle medians and ratios · identical 48–58 s window

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Planar solid-wall correction: native coupled trial
Ordinary native continuation from the identical 46 s state; amplitudes measured only in 48–58 s

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #505050

g.text: Curves retain physical accepted times. Candidate writes forces only; production also writes FVM/VPM profiles and surfaces.
Gray interval 46–48 s is excluded from all amplitude and timing statistics. Each cycle must be entirely contained in 48–58 s.
Raw = actual min–max of a complete cycle; drift correction subtracts the interpolated trough baseline. No phase shift is used.
Timing groups retain actual interface sweeps and sampling scope. A finite continuation window does not establish saturation.
